home.intro: Runners try to reach their target, hunters try to catch them. The app is the referee, so everyone can play.
home.codeHint: Use a runner, hunter or spectator code and your name. The code decides how you join. Everyone must join before the game starts; spectators need no location permission.
home.createText: Choose a playground on the map and get separate codes for runners, hunters and spectators.
home.devHint: Local development only. Location sharing and game rules are not implemented yet.
result.title: Game result
result.lookupHint: Enter the full game ID of a completed game, not a team join code. No joining or sign-in required.
result.invalidId: Enter the full game ID: 32 hexadecimal characters, not the 6-digit join code.
result.keepIdPrivate: Keep this ID safe and private: anyone who knows it can access the result.
result.unavailable: No result is available for this ID. The game may not exist or may not have ended yet.
result.invalidResponse: The backend returned an invalid game result. Please try again.
result.spectator: Watched only · did not take part in gameplay
result.summaryOnly: This is a basic summary, not a winner ranking.
replay.title: Replay
replay.legend: Each dot shows a player with the first letter of their name and a line of their last 30 minutes. The blue and red pins mark start and destination.
create.gridSized: {cells} × {cells} cells · approximately {cell} km × {cell} km each · {total} km × {total} km total
create.gridSizeLabel: Number of cells per side of the grid
create.gridSizeInvalid: Enter a whole number from 3 to 12.
create.revealIntervalHint: 1–60 minutes. This is how often hunters see where the runners are.
create.revealIntervalInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 60.
create.rotationHint: Grid rotation: {degrees}° clockwise. Turn the map with two fingers to turn the playground with it; row 1 (the destination) always stays on top. The north button resets it to 0°.
create.jokersHint: How often each joker may be used in this game. 0 disables it.
create.runnerJokers: Runner jokers (shared by all runners; fake position per runner)
create.zoneAlertHint: Passive, for each runner: one warning per hunter who enters the runner's zone.
create.cellSizeHint: 0.1–5 km, in steps of 0.1 km. Both comma and dot decimals work.
create.cellSizeInvalid: Enter 0.1–5 km in steps of 0.1 km.
create.sizeFirst: Enter a valid cell size first.
create.pickCenter: Pan the map to move the grid onto your playing area, or tap to place it.
create.checkGrid: Check the entire grid is suitable and permitted for outdoor play, then create the game.
create.center: Center: {latitude}, {longitude} · Columns A–{lastColumn}, rows 1–{rows} from north to south
create.creating: Creating game and finding landmarks for the route (this can take a few seconds)...
create.routeHint: Automatic: the server picks a landmark in the southern edge row (start) and one in the northern edge row (destination); runners can get a new route twice. On the map: you place both points yourself, and the route stays fixed.
create.routeTap: Tap the blue southern edge row for the start and the red northern edge row for the destination.
create.routeTapEdge: The start must lie in the southern and the destination in the northern edge row.
create.routePointMoved: {point}: no longer in its edge row, please set it again
create.created: Game created. Share the codes, then join as a player or spectator yourself.
joinCodes.heading: Join codes
joinCodes.hint: Share the code for the intended team or for watching. Everyone, including spectators, must join before the game starts. There are 30 places in total.
joinCodes.shareFailed: Could not open sharing. You can still select and copy the code.
playground.cellSizeInvalid: Cell size must be 0.1–5 km in steps of 0.1 km.
playground.gridSizeInvalid: The grid must have 3 to 12 cells per side.
playground.rotationInvalid: The grid rotation must be 0 to 359 whole degrees.
playground.revealIntervalInvalid: The reveal interval must be 1 to 60 whole minutes.
playground.jokerAllowanceInvalid: Each joker allowance must be a whole number from 0 to 5.
playground.latitudeInvalid: Choose a center between 80° south and 80° north.
playground.dateLine: The playground cannot cross the international date line.
map.alignGrid: Align the map with the grid (row 1 on top)
client.name: Enter a name with 1–{max} characters.
client.teamName: Enter a team name with 1–{max} characters.
client.timeout: Connection timed out. Check the API URL and your network.
client.createTimeout: Finding landmarks for the route took too long. Please try again.
client.routeTimeout: Finding a new route took too long. The lobby will show shortly whether it changed.
client.unreachable: Could not reach the backend. Check the API URL and your network.
location.notificationTitle: Catch me! is sharing your location
location.notificationBody: Your team sees your position while the game runs.
lobby.title: Lobby
lobby.testMode: TEST MODE — start and finish checks disabled
lobby.testModeText: Ready, countdown and finish confirmation work anywhere. Active players still share real GPS locations. Do not use for real games.
lobby.countdownInfo: Everyone is ready. Joining, leaving, un-readying, or a runner moving away from the start cancels the countdown.
lobby.countdownInfoTest: Everyone is ready. Joining, leaving, or un-readying cancels the countdown.
lobby.startInfo: The game starts 10 seconds after all runners and hunters are ready and both teams have at least one player. Runners must be at the start of the route; hunters need a hunter team. Spectators do not ready up.
lobby.startInfoTest: The game starts 10 seconds after all runners and hunters are ready and both teams have at least one player. Hunters need a hunter team. Spectators do not ready up.
lobby.revealHunter: Every {minutes} min you see where each runner was at that moment.
lobby.revealRunner: Every {minutes} min the hunters see where you are at that moment.
lobby.legendRunner: ● You (green) · teammates (blue) · hunters from the "Show hunters" joker (brown) · caught runners (black ×). Runners never see hunters live.
lobby.legendHunter: ● You (green) · your hunter team (blue) · revealed runners (red) · joker results such as compass arrows (orange) · your team's sketches (purple) · caught runners (black ×). Runners never see hunters live.
lobby.shareRunnerStart: Runners must prove they are at the start of the route before getting ready.
lobby.shareHunterLobby: Your hunter team sees your position, already in the lobby.
lobby.shareRunning: Your teammates see your position while the game runs.
lobby.shareRunningForeground: Your teammates see your position while the game runs. It is only shared while this screen is open.
lobby.locationBlocked: Location access is blocked. Allow it in the system settings.
lobby.sharingForeground: Sharing while the screen is on
lobby.sharingBackgroundText: Your position keeps being shared when the screen is off or you switch apps, until you leave the game screen or close the app.
lobby.backgroundUnavailable: Keep this screen open. Background sharing needs an installed app build; Expo Go cannot share in the background.
lobby.allowAlways: Allow "Always" location access to keep sharing when the screen is off.
lobby.backgroundBlocked: Background location is blocked. Allow "Always" in the system settings, or keep this screen open.
lobby.locationRequired: You cannot get ready without location access.
lobby.backgroundRequired: Before you can get ready, allow "Always" location access. That way your position keeps being shared during the game when the screen is off.
lobby.backgroundRequiredBlocked: "Always" is blocked. Allow it in the app's system settings, otherwise you cannot get ready.
lobby.route: Get from {start} to {stop} without being caught. Straight-line distance: {distance} km.
lobby.goToStart: You are {meters} m from the start. Get within {radius} m to get ready.
lobby.checkDisabled: The start-position check is disabled for testing.
lobby.newRouteHint: The route applies to all runners. Together you can change it twice.
lobby.findingRoute: Finding landmarks for a new route (this can take a few seconds)...
lobby.unreadyForRoute: All runners must be not ready to change the route.
lobby.needHunterTeam: Join or create a hunter team to get ready.
lobby.hunterTeamHint: Hunters of the same team see each other's positions. Other hunter teams never see yours.
lobby.unreadyForTeam: Set yourself not ready to change your team.
lobby.countdownHint: Get to your position. Anyone who un-readies or leaves cancels the countdown.
catch.confirmText: You will permanently leave active play and can no longer use jokers. Location sharing will stop. If a location was reported, your last reported position will immediately become visible to everyone as a black marker. You can keep watching. This cannot be undone.
catch.spectating: You are out and now watching the game.
catch.sharingStopped: Your location is no longer being shared. Only your last reported position when you were caught stays visible.
catch.noJokers: You are caught and can no longer use jokers.
catch.markerTime: Marked caught at {time} · last reported position
finish.confirmText: You will permanently finish your run. Location sharing will stop and you can no longer use jokers. Your finish location will not be shown to hunters. You can keep watching; the game continues for everyone else. This cannot be undone.
finish.spectating: Your run is complete. You are now watching; the game continues for everyone else.
finish.sharingStopped: Your location is no longer being shared. Your finish location is not shown to hunters.
finish.noJokers: You have finished and can no longer use jokers.
finish.notEligible: Finish confirmation is no longer available. Wait for a fresh location report within 50 m of the target.
spectator.title: Spectator
spectator.lobbyInfo: You are watching. No ready-up or location permission is needed. You will see all player locations only after the game starts, then the spectator map opens automatically. Joining or leaving before the start does not affect the countdown.
spectator.info: You see the latest real reports from all runners and hunter teams, without reveal delays or fake positions. Tap a marker for its name, team/status and report time. × marks a catch; ✓ a finished runner's frozen last report. Missing or expired reports have no marker. The runner route's start and destination are marked just as for runners. Joker snapshots and sketches are not shown.
spectator.fairPlay: Fair play: do not pass hidden locations to active players. You cannot return to active play.
spectator.noTracking: Your location is no longer tracked or shared. Watching needs no location permission.
timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.trapTriggered: A runner walked into hunter team {team}'s trap
timeline.zoneAlert: {name} was warned: {hunter} ({team}) was in the same zone
spectator.noJokers: Spectators cannot use jokers or take gameplay actions.
spectator.frozenReport: Last report before finishing · no longer tracked
joker.title: Jokers
joker.showRunners.title: Show runners
joker.showRunners.text: Your hunter team sees where every runner is right now. The positions stay on the map. The runners are told that your team did this.
joker.queryZone.title: Query a zone
joker.queryZone.text: Your hunter team learns whether at least one runner is in a cell you choose right now, but not how many or who. The answer stays on the map.
joker.compass.title: Compass
joker.compass.text: Your hunter team sees arrows from your position in the direction of every runner, but not how far away they are or which arrow is whose. The arrows stay on the map.
joker.compass.needsPosition: Available once your position is known.
joker.compass.used: The arrows on the map show in which direction the runners were.
joker.trap.title: Trap
joker.trap.text: Your hunter team sets a trap at a point in the playground. It becomes active 20 minutes later and triggers once as soon as a runner is within 100 m. You learn when, but not who. The runners are not told. The trap stays on the map as a circle.
joker.trap.confirmPoint: Set the trap at the point in cell {cell}? This uses one of your hunter team's uses.
joker.trap.active: Active since {time}, not triggered yet (orange circle)
joker.trap.triggered: Triggered at {time}: a runner was within 100 m (red circle).
joker.zoneOnly.title: Show only the zone
joker.zoneOnly.text: Shared by all runners: at the next reveal, hunters see only the cell you are in then, not your exact position.
joker.zoneOnly.used: At the first reveal after that, hunters saw only the cell of {name}.
joker.fakePosition.title: Fake position
joker.fakePosition.text: For you personally: you pick a point inside the playground. At the next reveal, hunters see you there instead of at your real position. Other runners keep their own uses.
joker.fakePosition.used: At the first reveal after that, hunters saw {name} at the chosen point in {cell}.
joker.choosePoint: Move the map until the crosshair is on the point:
joker.pointOutside: The point is outside the playground.
joker.confirmPoint: Use the point in cell {cell} for your next reveal? This uses one of your personal uses.
joker.showHunters.title: Show hunters
joker.showHunters.text: Shared by all runners: you see where every hunter is right now. The positions stay on the map. Hunters are not told.
joker.showHunters.noPositions: No hunter had reported a position yet.
joker.zoneAlert.title: Zone alert
joker.zoneAlert.text: Passive and just for you: you are warned once per hunter as soon as they are in your zone. You do not learn where exactly. Hunters are not told.
joker.located.title: Location queried
joker.located.text: Always on: you learn when which hunter team used “Show runners” to see your location. You do not learn what they saw.
joker.located.none: No hunter team has queried your location yet.
notification.denied: Notifications are off: you only see hunter warnings in the app. You can allow them in the system settings.
joker.confirmRunner: Use it now? This uses one of the uses shared by all runners.
joker.confirmPersonal: Use it now? This uses one of your personal uses.
joker.confirmCell: Query cell {cell} now? This uses one of your hunter team's uses.
joker.zoneFound: {cell}: at least one runner was inside.
joker.confirm: Use it now? This uses one of your hunter team's uses.
joker.waitForStart: Available once the game is running.
joker.noPositions: No runner had reported a position yet.
sketch.hint: Draw with your finger. Only your hunter team sees the lines.
sketch.clearText: The lines disappear for your whole hunter team.
game.exitText: Your position will no longer be shared, and you cannot rejoin.
